basis: Written from the published specification and established practice in the field; no new sources were read. Unreviewed.

distinguishingFeatures: Records a recognised discrepancy between observed and required states, not the work that fixes it.
Unlike a risk, it has already occurred; unlike an incident, it is not an operational response case.
Separates occurrence, detection, submission and ingestion times.

may: Register an issue from an intake submission.
Record causal analysis outcomes and dispositions.
mustNot: Overwrite a discrepancy statement or causal conclusion instead of adding a new assertion.
Expose reporter identity beyond the declared point.
Execute corrective actions within this model.
Delete a duplicate instead of retiring it with a link.
Conflate occurrence time with ingestion time.
requiresHuman: Accepting a disposition such as won't fix or use-as-is.

considerations: Reporters can face retaliation if their identity is exposed.
Safety issues left unresolved can harm people.

items: An issue has a discrepancy statement, a reference requirement, a reporter, a severity and a status.
Often confused with an incident, a risk, a change request and a corrective action.
Lost issues through bad duplicate merging.
